name: agrocylo-monorepo
description: Turborepo workspace root (Issue #755) tying the two Next.js clients and shared packages together, replacing independent per-app drift.
//overrides: Issue #1041: both workspaces pin react/react-dom 19.2.3, but npm also installed a hoisted root react/react-dom 19.2.8 (peer: true, pulled in to satisfy hoisted peer dependencies such as @testing-library/react). Two React copies means two ReactCurrentDispatcher objects, so a hook called by a component from one copy and a renderer from the other throws 'Invalid hook call'. Overriding both to the version the workspaces already declare collapses the tree onto one copy. NOTE: package-lock.json still records the pre-override tree; regenerate it with 'npm install' (scripts/check-react-runtime.js fails until then).
